shared_elements: low-relief carving on a natural stone surface
animal figure in profile with curved body outline
raised curvilinear contour lines against a flat ground
justification: Both show shallow, rounded relief in which an animal-like body in profile is set off from a plain stone ground, and both leave the surrounding rock surface unworked. But A is a single, eroded, hard-to-read motif spread over a horizontal weathered boulder, whereas B is a crisply cut, vertically organised pillar with several distinct creatures, arch shapes and a horizontal patterned band stacked in registers — a far more structured and legible composition.
